latest_release.name: v1.24.0
latest_release.body:
This release fixes another source of HTTP 503 errors when authenticating with an Apple ID.

## What's Changed
* entitlements: support Sign in with Apple by @victoragudo in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/377
* sdk: accept directories for tarball overrides  by @ap-1 in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/385
* deps: force OpenCombine in the DemoTCA lockfile by @ap-1 in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/391
* pack: link edited dependencies into the builder package by @ap-1 in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/390
* gsa: update user agent by @kabiroberai in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/406

## New Contributors
* @victoragudo made their first contribution in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/377
* @ap-1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/pull/385

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xtool-org/xtool/compare/1.23.0...1.24.0
